rejectedCandidates.title: Beirut River solar O&M tender as a new November announcement
rejectedCandidates.reason: Primary register dates announcement October 28, outside coverage. November 5 reporting is not a new procurement. Register and attached notice also disagree on clarification timing; no deadline claim promoted.

rejectedCandidates.title: EDL arrears disconnections and selective restoration
rejectedCandidates.reason: Current operational claims appear in November 2 media reporting, but EDL direct pages return 503 or connection failures. The older official decision establishes intended timing, not verified implementation or actual affected sites.

rejectedCandidates.title: Ogero outages and South Lebanon water restoration
rejectedCandidates.reason: November 3 media report retrieved; no current originating institutional statement retrieved. Social-post attribution and repeated reporting do not independently establish scope, causation or service restoration.

rejectedCandidates.title: Qatar talks as the cause of postponement or evidence of an approved energy deal
rejectedCandidates.reason: Official postponement notice gives no reason. Media attribution to ministerial travel does not establish a signed agreement, approved financing, new capacity or implementation. Publish only the separately verified schedule change.

rejectedCandidates.title: Salam–IFC meeting as a new energy investment commitment
rejectedCandidates.reason: Official November 4 readout confirms discussions but identifies no financed energy project, amount or delivery milestone. Retrieved IFC July appointment is background only. MENA/Nile retrieval failed; other discovery reports do not establish independent project-level corroboration. Retain discussions on watchlist.

rejectedCandidates.title: Climate-smart grants as a new energy award
rejectedCandidates.reason: Search discovery dates the programme announcement October 13, outside coverage. November 3 application deadline is not an award or disbursement; no current energy-specific outcome verified. Discovery-only, not source evidence.

rejectedCandidates.title: October private-generator rates as a new November tariff change
rejectedCandidates.reason: October 31 report falls outside coverage; controlling current tariff instrument not retrieved for a new in-window change. Search-discovery exclusion only.

rejectedCandidates.title: Earlier solar/BESS EOI and PPA reports as new project milestones
rejectedCandidates.reason: Search results refer to September EOI deadlines and October PPA announcements. No in-window financing, award, construction or commissioning evidence retrieved. Do not recycle old milestones.

rejectedCandidates.title: UNDP resident-representative appointment as energy news
